pages.text: MODIFICATION INSTRUCTIONS Replace the X-Y monitor with a modified monitor. Do ECN 978 on the CPU board. See attached instructions. Do ECN 991 on the X-Y timing board. See attached instruc- tions. Record the game and monitor serial numbers on the distri- butor record sheet. ‘ Place the colored label on the top left corner of the kick plate. . . Each team will have the number of games the distributor has purchased. There is a good possibility that number will not be in the distributor's location. Leave the correct number to make up the difference. The removed monitors should be loaded on your truck and returned to Gremlin with you. There will be special cases when these instructions will change. -Provide the distributor with a copy of the Distributor Record Sheet, ~ ~~ be sure to bring the original back with you.

pages.text: Monitor Removal Release the fasteners on the control panel and swing it down. Directly under the the front plexiglass, you will notice a small frame support piece. Grab it by the hand slot in the middle and pull it from the game. The front plexiglass can now be removed easily by lifting it on the bottom slightly and pulling it outward. Next, Sosy remove the interior graphics. The graphics frame, located directly behind the interior graphics, can be removed by gripping two sides and carefully lifting it out. Now open the the rear panel on the cabinet and disconnect the power cable and video cable to the monitor. Now... go back to the front and remove the four bolts in each corner of the monitor board. Now grasp the board by the hand holds provided at LS the top and bottom and pull the monitor from the cabinet. To replace —-- -—follow -the same -procedure in reverse except you will notice on the rear - -. of the new monitor there is an extra board added. Mount this board on-the cabinet with the tie wraps provided and the connector coming from this board is plugged into the video cable. Reconnect the power ~ . cable as usual. Before closing up, ensure that the heat sinks on the driver transistors are not touching each other.
